name: Close-Grip Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
steps: Grip closely spaced parallel handles on a pull-up bar with palms facing each other and arms extended.
Set your shoulder blades slightly down and brace your core to keep your torso steady.
Pull your elbows down toward your waist until your chin rises above your hands.
Lower yourself smoothly under control until your arms straighten again.
tips: Keep your legs quiet as you pull instead of swinging for momentum.
Pull your chest toward the handles and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
